question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

SUPPRESS
solution: The correct answer is '**Release**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Suppress**' is '**Release**'. • **Suppress**: to stop something by using force. (बल के प्रयोग से किसी को शांत कर देना; दमन करना) • *Example: to **suppress** the truth...* • **Release**: to allow somebody/something to be free. [व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना] • *Example: He’s been **released** from prison.* **Correct Answer:__** *Release.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Abolish**: to end law or system officially. (किसी क़ानून या प्रथा को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्‍त करना) • **Quash**: to say that an official decision is no longer true or legal. (आधिकारिक निर्णय को रद्द कर देना) • **Contain**: have or hold (someone or something) within. (भीतर (किसी को या कुछ) रखना) ce:T655, The correct answer is **'Discern the hidden meaning in the text'.**
